title: Comparison of normalized coefficient unit arrows
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a tower base b, Noetherian schemes X and S, an isomorphism e:X≅P¹_S over f:X→S, its recorded geometry g and coefficient pullback c [def-sp-tower-shriek-data, def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. At a level n, assume R(l,E,n) finite (as b already ensures), and put A=ULift R(l,E,n). Let F be the derived canonical fixed-scalar-to-intrinsic realization on S [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction]. There are isomorphisms a:F(geoP1Unit A S)≅Ev_n(unit_S) and z:F(Rp_* geoP1Unit A P¹_S)≅Ev_n(push_g(unit_X)) such that F(nu_S(p1DecompositionUnit A S);geoP1PushComparison A p) followed by z equals a followed by Ev_n(unitArrow(c)). Here p:P¹_S→S and all the fixed-scalar unit and comparison maps are those of [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. This is a commuting square of full derived arrows; no cohomology, Chern class, decomposition, or invertibility of l on S is asserted or assumed. Equivalently, these comparisons and their square form an isomorphism between the two objects of the arrow category, as in the Lean statement.

source.place: paragraph (1), the unit and Chern components of finite projective-line cohomology (G2)

proof.text: Expand the etale/pro-etale direct-image mate. Naturality of the adjunction bijection identifies the compared p1DecompositionUnit with the pro-etale adjunction unit followed by the pushforward of geoP1UnitPullback. This last map is invertible, giving the first arrow isomorphism. No invertibility theorem for the direct-image mate is used.

The intrinsic tensor direct image agrees with the realization-normalized intrinsic direct image because their coefficient maps are the same adjunct. Left-adjoint uniqueness gives an ordinary pullback isomorphism, which descends by exact functors. Compose with the pullback compositor and the equality e.hom followed by the projection equals f. Pullback along e is an equivalence. Conjugate the resulting left-adjoint isomorphism under the two realization/equivalence adjunctions. The conjugate is invertible and its unit equation supplies an isomorphism of the two unit arrows.

Use the constant-sheaf comparison and canonical intrinsic regular-module realization, then exact single-complex comparisons. The equality defining level evaluation gives an invertible map from the regular intrinsic module to the evaluated tower coefficient object, sectionwise the corresponding ring isomorphism. This constructs the source comparison.

Expand unitArrow, apply geometry_adjunction_evaluation, and use naturality of pushEvaluation to move the image of c.derivedIso across it. Cancel pullEvaluation with its inverse. Naturality of the native adjunction unit transports the source isomorphism, and pushforward of the pullback/source and coefficient isomorphisms constructs the target comparison. Compose the four arrow isomorphisms. Because the theorem only asserts existence of an arrow isomorphism, its target comparison can absorb c.derivedIso; no scalar-normalization equality or cohomology calculation is needed.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), coefficient-unit component; shorter proof by mates, adjoint uniqueness, and the proved tower evaluation identity (G5)

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_unit_arrow_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) {f : X ⟶ S}
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (he : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f) (c : CoefficientPullback l E b f g)
    (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)] :
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)
    let F := (Scheme.sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence S
      (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)).functor.mapDerivedCategory
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      (F.map ((geoP1Comparison A S).map (Etale.p1DecompositionUnit A S) ≫
        geoP1PushComparison A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)
          (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).map (unitArrow l E c)))
